message: Last winter, we got hit with a snowstorm that had everyone rushing around. Instead of worrying about the power going out, I decided to embrace the chaos. I grabbed some blankets, made a big pot of chili, and set up a little ‘snow day’ in the living room. We played board games by candlelight and told stories until the snow stopped falling. Sometimes, the best part of an unexpected situation is how you choose to spend it. What do you like to do when the weather keeps you cozy at home?
